Write deterministic regression tests for clamp(value, low, high) in generated_tests.keel. Callers guarantee low <= high. Return low below low, high above high, otherwise value, for signed 64-bit integers. Tests must pass correct implementations and detect boundary/branch bugs. Do not change implementation or existing tests; add test blocks only.
Edit only: generated_tests.keel. Preserve other files, interfaces, contracts, and existing tests. An independent evaluator checks your result after you exit. Do not read outside the workspace, use network access, or delegate. The workspace contains all public task files and ./keel. Complete the change and validate it.
Keel: fn f(x: Int) -> Int { return x }; let immutable, var mutable; if/while/for use braces. Int is checked signed 64-bit. Lists: [1, 2], []; no implicit conversions. Owned Text/List parameters use read/edit/take; mutation calls use edit, and owned copies require explicit clone. Compute reads before an exclusive edit borrow. Match both Ok(value)/Err(message) or Some(value)/None arms. Tests: test "name" { assert expression }. No shadowing. `result` is reserved for postconditions, even without contracts; name locals/parameters `output` or another identifier. For exact syntax use ./keel agent spec language or collections; for signatures ./keel api NAME --json. TESTED means sampled cases, never proof.
Write test blocks using ordinary text edits. Validate with `python3 workflow.py validate`. Do not add functions, properties, or implementation code.
First inspect `./keel inspect . --symbol clamp --json`; read relevant public files as needed.

artifacts.generated_tests.keel:
// Add regression tests here.

test "positive interval boundaries and branches" {
    assert clamp(-100, 3, 9) == 3
    assert clamp(2, 3, 9) == 3
    assert clamp(3, 3, 9) == 3
    assert clamp(4, 3, 9) == 4
    assert clamp(6, 3, 9) == 6
    assert clamp(8, 3, 9) == 8
    assert clamp(9, 3, 9) == 9
    assert clamp(10, 3, 9) == 9
    assert clamp(100, 3, 9) == 9
}

test "negative interval boundaries and branches" {
    assert clamp(-100, -12, -4) == -12
    assert clamp(-13, -12, -4) == -12
    assert clamp(-12, -12, -4) == -12
    assert clamp(-11, -12, -4) == -11
    assert clamp(-8, -12, -4) == -8
    assert clamp(-5, -12, -4) == -5
    assert clamp(-4, -12, -4) == -4
    assert clamp(-3, -12, -4) == -4
    assert clamp(0, -12, -4) == -4
    assert clamp(100, -12, -4) == -4
}

test "interval crossing zero" {
    assert clamp(-8, -7, 11) == -7
    assert clamp(-7, -7, 11) == -7
    assert clamp(-6, -7, 11) == -6
    assert clamp(-1, -7, 11) == -1
    assert clamp(0, -7, 11) == 0
    assert clamp(1, -7, 11) == 1
    assert clamp(10, -7, 11) == 10
    assert clamp(11, -7, 11) == 11
    assert clamp(12, -7, 11) == 11
}

test "zero endpoints and adjacent bounds" {
    assert clamp(-1, 0, 1) == 0
    assert clamp(0, 0, 1) == 0
    assert clamp(1, 0, 1) == 1
    assert clamp(2, 0, 1) == 1
    assert clamp(-2, -1, 0) == -1
    assert clamp(-1, -1, 0) == -1
    assert clamp(0, -1, 0) == 0
    assert clamp(1, -1, 0) == 0
}

test "singleton intervals" {
    assert clamp(-1, 0, 0) == 0
    assert clamp(0, 0, 0) == 0
    assert clamp(1, 0, 0) == 0
    assert clamp(6, 7, 7) == 7
    assert clamp(7, 7, 7) == 7
    assert clamp(8, 7, 7) == 7
    assert clamp(-8, -7, -7) == -7
    assert clamp(-7, -7, -7) == -7
    assert clamp(-6, -7, -7) == -7
}

test "full signed integer interval preserves values" {
    let minimum = -9223372036854775807 - 1
    let maximum = 9223372036854775807
    assert clamp(minimum, minimum, maximum) == minimum
    assert clamp(minimum + 1, minimum, maximum) == minimum + 1
    assert clamp(-4294967296, minimum, maximum) == -4294967296
    assert clamp(-1, minimum, maximum) == -1
    assert clamp(0, minimum, maximum) == 0
    assert clamp(1, minimum, maximum) == 1
    assert clamp(4294967296, minimum, maximum) == 4294967296
    assert clamp(maximum - 1, minimum, maximum) == maximum - 1
    assert clamp(maximum, minimum, maximum) == maximum
}

test "extreme inputs clamp without overflowing" {
    let minimum = -9223372036854775807 - 1
    let maximum = 9223372036854775807
    assert clamp(minimum, -7, 11) == -7
    assert clamp(maximum, -7, 11) == 11
    assert clamp(minimum, 3, 9) == 3
    assert clamp(maximum, -12, -4) == -4
    assert clamp(minimum, minimum + 1, maximum - 1) == minimum + 1
    assert clamp(maximum, minimum + 1, maximum - 1) == maximum - 1
    assert clamp(0, minimum + 1, maximum - 1) == 0
    assert clamp(minimum, maximum, maximum) == maximum
    assert clamp(maximum, maximum, maximum) == maximum
    assert clamp(maximum, minimum, minimum) == minimum
    assert clamp(minimum, minimum, minimum) == minimum
}

test "narrow intervals near integer limits" {
    let minimum = -9223372036854775807 - 1
    let maximum = 9223372036854775807
    assert clamp(minimum, minimum, minimum + 2) == minimum
    assert clamp(minimum + 1, minimum, minimum + 2) == minimum + 1
    assert clamp(minimum + 2, minimum, minimum + 2) == minimum + 2
    assert clamp(minimum + 3, minimum, minimum + 2) == minimum + 2
    assert clamp(maximum, minimum, minimum + 2) == minimum + 2
    assert clamp(maximum - 3, maximum - 2, maximum) == maximum - 2
    assert clamp(maximum - 2, maximum - 2, maximum) == maximum - 2
    assert clamp(maximum - 1, maximum - 2, maximum) == maximum - 1
    assert clamp(maximum, maximum - 2, maximum) == maximum
    assert clamp(minimum, maximum - 2, maximum) == maximum - 2
}

test "bounds beyond signed 32 bit range" {
    assert clamp(4294967295, 4294967296, 4294967300) == 4294967296
    assert clamp(4294967296, 4294967296, 4294967300) == 4294967296
    assert clamp(4294967297, 4294967296, 4294967300) == 4294967297
    assert clamp(4294967300, 4294967296, 4294967300) == 4294967300
    assert clamp(4294967301, 4294967296, 4294967300) == 4294967300
    assert clamp(-4294967301, -4294967300, -4294967296) == -4294967300
    assert clamp(-4294967300, -4294967300, -4294967296) == -4294967300
    assert clamp(-4294967297, -4294967300, -4294967296) == -4294967297
    assert clamp(-4294967296, -4294967300, -4294967296) == -4294967296
    assert clamp(-4294967295, -4294967300, -4294967296) == -4294967296
}
